hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Each selected child decreases the happiness of all unselected children by 1.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Sort children descending by happiness to select the most joyful children early.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: For the i-th chosen child, add max(0, happiness[i] - i) to the total.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: k: number of children to select
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all combinations of k children is O(n choose k).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Sort greedily and subtract the turn index i from happiness[i].
